answer.origin: NVIDIA Corporation, in its Form 8-K filed with the SEC on August 17, 2026, reporting agreements entered into that day; the report says the form of the agreements will be filed with its Form 10-Q for the fiscal quarter ended July 26, 2026.
answer.note: NVIDIA reports that on August 17, 2026 it entered into multiple residual value guaranties with SB Energy relating to leases for approximately 4.25 GW of IT load at the Portsmouth Site. NVIDIA says its aggregate payment obligation for this initial commitment is cumulatively capped at $105 billion. The agreements generally become effective when the relevant leases commence, and payments depend on specified conditions, including the lessor meeting ready-for-service conditions, expected to begin in 2028. The guarantee is triggered by specified OpenAI tenant defaults, including insolvency resulting in lease default or failure to pay; the potential payment generally covers a shortfall against guaranteed minimum lease value after replacement leasing or sale recoveries. OpenAI has agreed to reimburse and indemnify NVIDIA for amounts NVIDIA actually pays. The filing also says NVIDIA may, at its sole discretion, provide credit support for approximately an additional 3.8 GW; it does not report that this additional support has been exercised. OpenAI is the tenant and is expected to use the 4.25 GW capacity for NVIDIA’s DSX AI factory platform. This is evidence of a large, conditional contingent obligation and of planned customer use of NVIDIA’s platform at the site—not evidence that NVIDIA has paid the capped amount, that the additional capacity is committed, or that the planned deployment has occurred. The exposure depends on lease commencement and readiness, tenant performance, recovery value, and the agreements’ termination provisions.
limitations: The 8-K’s description is expressly incomplete; the referenced agreement forms and their detailed terms are not included in this source.
The report gives an aggregate cap for the initial commitment but not the lease-by-lease allocation, a payment schedule, or any amount currently paid.
The filing describes additional support for approximately 3.8 GW as discretionary but does not say whether NVIDIA has exercised that option.
The expected start of ready-for-service conditions is a forward-looking expectation, not a reported completed milestone.
follow_up: Review the agreement forms in NVIDIA’s Form 10-Q for the fiscal quarter ended July 26, 2026, when filed, for detailed conditions, allocation, remedies, and termination terms.
Check subsequent NVIDIA filings for lease commencement and ready-for-service status, any exercise of the additional 3.8 GW support, and any reported guarantee payments or recoveries.
At NVIDIA’s next annual filing, check the reported status and amount of the Portsmouth contingent obligation and whether any payments or changes to the cap have occurred.

proposal.question: What Portsmouth residual-value-guaranty obligation does NVIDIA report at its next annual filing, including any changes to the initial aggregate cap or payments made?
proposal.settled_by: NVIDIA’s next annual filing, checking its disclosure of the Portsmouth agreements, aggregate cap, and any payments or changes in obligation.
proposal.time_scope: Next annual filing after the August 17, 2026 agreements.
proposal.lost_if_folded: Folding this into a general partnership or customer-deployment question would lose the distinct monitoring of NVIDIA’s undertaken, conditional financial obligation and any reported change or payment.
